exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-16T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix routine-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: routine-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# Routines use the generic issue creation surface.
exec card create --priority 1 'Ordinary task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ordinary.txt
exec card create --priority 0 --type routine --summary 'Repeat this procedure.' 'Periodic review'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/routine.txt
exec card create --priority 4 'Routine prerequisite'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/prerequisite.txt
exec card create --priority 0 --type routine --depends-on routine-3 'Blocked routine'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/blocked-routine.txt

# Routine issues stay out of ordinary execution pools but remain listable by
# their first-class type.
exec card --json ready
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ready.jsonl
exec card --json blocked
! stdout .
exec card --json list --type routine
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/routines.jsonl

# An unqualified claim skips routines. A routine remains directly claimable
# and releasable by its ID.
exec card --actor worker --json claim
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/ordinary-claim.json
exec card --actor worker release routine-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ordinary-release.txt
exec card --actor caretaker --json claim routine-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/routine-claim.json
exec card --actor caretaker release routine-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/routine-release.txt

# Existing generic mutation and batch surfaces accept routine.
exec card --json edit routine-1 --type routine
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/edited.json
exec card apply graph.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt

# Dump renders routine without a special export format.
exec card dump --issue routine-5 --no-descendants routine-dump
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump.txt
cmp routine-dump/issues/routine-5.md $WORK/golden/routine-5.md

# Routine closure is explicit and does not require a result.
exec card --json close routine-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/closed.json

# Context-sensitive command help exposes routine behavior without introducing
# routine-specific commands.
exec card create --help
stdout 'routine'
exec card edit --help
stdout 'routine'
exec card list --help
stdout 'routine'
exec card claim --help
stdout 'routine'
